badge.help:
Use Nenolink Standard Badges or select a folder containing your own badge images.

Use clear filenames, for example:
my-company-ai-assisted.png

The filename is used as the display name for custom badges.

Supported formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG and WEBP.
Transparent PNG is recommended.
